name: 浴血江湖
english_name: Blood-Soaked Jianghu III: Return to the Jianghu
english_description: Blood-Soaked Jianghu III: Return to the Jianghu, published by KMMUD.COM. Registration runs through an English ID, then a full Chinese name entered as a single string (no separate surname/given-name split), a dual-password system (admin password plus login password), a talent menu (0 for a random full set, y to accept), email, and gender. Its map and code closely track the 'Tianya' family's wlhd (Wulin Haodang / Jin Yong's Dream II) — its signature cliff-jump scene is byte-for-byte identical to wlhd's independently rewritten version — suggesting this archive evolved from, or alongside, wlhd, a lineage relationship no earlier archive in this collection had documented.
